<function name="OnClickLine" parent="DListView" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
<internal>Use <page>DListView:OnRowSelected</page> instead!</internal>

Called whenever a line is clicked.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="line" type="Panel">The selected line.</arg>
		<arg name="isSelected" type="boolean">Boolean indicating whether the line is selected.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
